validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION/OWNERSHIP: this is a real, heavily-documented project, not GEM-only. It is 'BBSh-2' ('вторая нитка' / second line/string) of the Beineu-Bozoy-Shymkent trunk gas pipeline -- a physically separate NEW pipe QazaqGaz is building alongside the already-operating first line (BSGP LLC), NOT a construction phase of the existing pipe. Correctly classified transmission (not gathering/feeder). Existence chain, all independent of gem.wiki/GEM: (1) QazaqGaz's own 2024 Integrated Annual Report (qazaqgaz.kz PDF) lists 'Строительство второй нитки МГ Бейнеу-Бозой-Шымкент' as an active capital project with a signed QazaqGaz+UCC Holding cooperation agreement, TEO under expertise review, and technical spec/routing already developed; (2) primeminister.kz (official PM's-office press release, 31 Jul 2025) states construction began April 2025 with commissioning targeted end of 2026; (3) vlast.kz (30-31 Jul 2025, quoting Samruk-Kazyna's chairman after Tokaev's Qatar meeting) independently confirms the 2026 commissioning target; (4) newscentralasia.net (30 Oct 2025) and kz.kursiv.media (28 Feb 2023, 21 Feb 2025) trace the deal back to a Feb 2024 Doha signing ceremony (Emir of Qatar + President Tokaev) and a Dec 2024 EPC-contract award to UCC Holding. Not a duplicate within this batch's roster: P6712 ('Beineu-Bozoy-Shymkent Gas Pipeline', len=0, cap=5.0, proposed) is correctly modeled as a companion capacity-expansion-only row for this same second-line project's later stage (see spec finding below) -- not a double-count of P5788. OWNERSHIP: Owner1=QazaqGaz / Owner2=UCC Holding confirmed independently by www.kt.kz (3 May 2024, 'QazaqGaz и UCC Holding пришли к консенсусу по всем четырем важнейшим проектам', explicitly naming the BBS second line among the four) and by QazaqGaz's own AR2024 ('Соглашение о совместной реализации между QazaqGaz и UCC Holding' for BBS-2). newscentralasia additionally identifies UCC Holding as a subsidiary of Qatar's Power International Holding (the wiki-cited powerholding-intl.com page). The current sheet's Owner [ref] URL is malformed (missing hostname: 'https:///rus/ekonomika/...') -- the intended page is https://www.kt.kz/rus/ekonomika/stroitelstvo_gazopererabatyvayuschih_zavodov_v_rk_usloviya_1377964033.html (this exact URL is also in the row's own gem.wiki citation list, cite_note-:15-13); fix staged in fills[]. SegmentCost=6,900,000,000 USD (2024): the existing_ref_checks flag on the QazaqGaz AR2024 PDF as a false negative -- I pulled the PDF directly (pdftotext -layout; it's a 17MB/~300pp document, past the automated checker's extraction depth per url_verifier.py's own documented large-PDF caveat) and found the exact line item: '3. Увеличение мощности МГ «Бейнеу – Бозой – Шымкент» (строительство второй нитки) ... Общая стоимость 6,9 млрд долл. США' -- SegmentCost is CONFIRMED correct and correctly sourced; no fill needed, just noting the checker's false negative for the record.

validity.recommendation: Swap the Capacity [ref] from adilet.zan.kz (which does not actually name this stage -- see below) to https://kz.kursiv.media/2025-02-21/zhnb-qazaqgazgazpipeplans/ , which explicitly and independently supports the 10.00 bcm/y value. Leave Length/Diameter/Pressure values as-is (no confirmed alternate exists) but flag their citation as misattributed and open a follow-up to source segment II's own EPC-level specs once public.
validity.researcher_notes: Capacity=10.00 bcm/y: the CURRENT ref (adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/G23JVM00350#z250, the 2023 'General Gasification Scheme') does not actually support this value for segment II -- per this batch's own scope notes, para 165 of that document states the ALREADY-OPERATING first line was commissioned in 2013 at 10 bcm/y; the checker's 'value found' pass on this ref is a coincidental match against the wrong physical asset, not confirmation of segment II's capacity. Directly on-topic, independent sourcing exists and DOES support 10.00 for segment II specifically, once you resolve a two-stage capacity structure: kz.kursiv.media (21 Feb 2025), quoting a QazaqGaz company statement verbatim: 'мощность первого этапа второй очереди... составит до 10 млрд кубометров газа в год, второго – 15 млрд кубометров... совокупная мощность газопровода составит 30 млрд кубометров в год' (Stage-1 capacity of the second line = up to 10 bcm/y; Stage-2 [cumulative] = 15 bcm/y; system total once both are built = 30 bcm/y, against an existing first-line capacity that this same article and bsgp.kz's own 15th-anniversary page independently put at ~15 bcm/y today, i.e. above its original 10 bcm/y design after the 2018 EBRD-financed modernisation). This reconciles neatly with the roster: P5788 (this row, cap=10.00, status=construction, StartYear1=2026) = Stage 1; P6712 (cap=5.0, len=0, RouteType='Capacity expansion only', status=proposed) = Stage 2, since 10+5=15 matches the second line's own cumulative design capacity, and 15(existing)+15(both stages of line 2)=30 matches the stated system total exactly. QazaqGaz's AR2024 independently states (ESG risk register) design capacity of 'до 15 млрд м3 в год' for '2 нитка' overall -- consistent. Two independent sources (kursiv, QazaqGaz's own AR2024) corroborate the 10/15/30 structure, so I'm treating Capacity=10.00 as CONFIRMED, just mis-cited -- recommend the ref swap above (tier upgraded to high with the swap). Length=1449.00km / Diameter=1067mm / Pressure=9.81MPa: these are IDENTICAL, to the decimal/unit, to the ALREADY-OPERATING first line's own official spec (QazaqGaz AR2024, page ~16, 'Основные характеристики ТОО Газопровод Бейнеу-Шымкент в 2024 году': Протяженность 1 449,50 км, Диаметр 1 067 мм) -- strong circumstantial evidence these three fields were carried over from the first line's spec rather than researched for the new, physically separate second line. This is not necessarily wrong -- a parallel/looping second string is often built to the same diameter along the same corridor, so matching length/diameter is physically plausible -- but no independent source gives segment II's OWN length, diameter, or pressure. The closest attempt, newscentralasia.net (30 Oct 2025), gives 'около 1600 километров трубопровода и шесть компрессорных станций' for the broader BBSh-expansion package, ~150km more than the sheet's figure, but the scope of that figure is ambiguous (the same Qatar-QazaqGaz deal it's describing also bundles the unrelated Aktobe-Kostanay line P6834 and a KS-14 compressor spur in the same paragraph, so it may not be segment II's length alone). Not proposing a Length/Diameter/Pressure change without an EPC-level source; flagging for a follow-up once segment II's own design documents become public. Pressure 9.81 MPa is at least consistent with the top of Intergas Central Asia's stated 3-9.81 MPa system-wide operating-pressure range (AR2024), so it is plausible even if not segment-II-specific.

fills.researcher_notes: Best-effort search (RU-language: BBS + Karachaganak/Tengiz/Kashagan feed) turned up general confirmation that Kazakhstan's western fields (Tengiz, Karachaganak, Kashagan) feed the Central Asia-Center system that the BBS corridor draws on, and that QazaqGaz's AR2024 shows the existing first line's 2024 throughput was dominated by TRANSIT gas (36.1 of 45.12 bcm was Turkmen/Uzbek transit to China), leaving only the remainder as domestically-sourced southern supply. I could not find a source that specifically ties segment II's own gas feed to West Kazakhstan fields (as opposed to continuing to carry transit gas, or drawing on a mixed supply) -- left UNRESOLVED rather than force a citation. Leaving the current value in place (plausible, unconfirmed) since standing rule 2 forbids fabricating a ref.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status='construction' with ConstructionYear=2025/Month=4 and StartYear1=2026 all hold up and are the newest evidence available. primeminister.kz (official PM's-office release, 31 Jul 2025, quoting Deputy PM Roman Sklyar): 'В апреле началось строительство второй нитки магистрального газопровода «Бейнеу – Бозой – Шымкент». Ее ввод в эксплуатацию планируется к концу следующего года' (construction started April [2025]; commissioning planned end of next year [2026]) -- directly confirms both dates already on the sheet. Independently corroborated by vlast.kz (30-31 Jul 2025, Akorda/Samruk-Kazyna chair Nurlan Zhakupov after Tokaev's Doha meeting): 'газопровод Актобе-Костанай и вторая нитка газопровода Бейнеу-Бозой-Шымкент будут сданы в 2026 году' (both slated for 2026), and by newscentralasia.net (30 Oct 2025), which traces the EPC contract to UCC Holding's Dec 2024 award and describes active construction of '~1600km of pipe and six compressor stations' as part of the deal. This is the newest dated evidence found (Oct 2025); no evidence of delay, cancellation, or an earlier-than-2026 commissioning turned up. Not disturbing Status/ConstructionYear/StartYear1.
